title: Best MCP Servers for Job Search and Auto-Apply in 2026, Ranked
summary: Compare job-search MCP servers by search, résumé preparation, submission and tracking. See which capabilities are documented and what setup each needs.
body_markdown:
**Yes, an MCP server can give a connected AI assistant the tools to start job applications for you.** Tsenta and JobGPT document application tools as well as job search, while projects such as JobSpy MCP focus on finding listings. The best MCP for job search depends on whether you want search results, a prepared résumé or a completed application workflow.


Updated November 5, 2026. Tsenta publishes this comparison and sells one of the services. The order prioritizes documented submission and tracking, setup clarity and candidate control. We checked source and vendor documentation; we did not run a live application benchmark across these services. A tool named “apply” is not proof that it succeeds on every employer.


## Job MCP servers compared


Server Search and résumé capabilities Submission and tracking ATS coverage evidence Setup and clients Price evidence


**Tsenta** Matching roles, résumé profiles and tailored application materials Starts supported cloud applications; reads applications, tracker and inbox[30+ supported employer systems](https://tsenta.com/ai-disclosure) , including Workday Hosted server with browser sign-in;[client guides](https://tsenta.com/mcp) for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex First 25 applications free; global USD monthly plans from $19/600 per 30-day cycle


**JobGPT, 6figr** Search, saved job hunts, résumé generation and match scoring` apply_to_job` , application records and status tools documented README names import examples, not a complete validated submission matrix[Hosted endpoint or local server](https://github.com/6figr-com/jobgpt-mcp-server) ; Claude, Cursor, Codex and other clients documented Some actions use credits; verify current account offer


**autoapply-mcp, niragmehta** Discovery, eligibility gates and evidence-based application packets Manual, assisted or automatic modes; approvals and audit history README separates discovery from submission and notes limitations for Workday and newer sources[Local Node.js server](https://github.com/niragmehta/autoapply-mcp) , stdio client; Playwright for browser modes No service subscription listed; local setup and any external services remain


**Hidden Jobs / job-search-mcp** Remote-job sources, saved CV versions, tailoring and PDF export Client-assisted submission described; saved applications and outcomes No general ATS submission matrix established[Hosted OAuth server](https://github.com/hiddenjobs/job-search-mcp) ; assistant and browser capabilities affect actions Verify current Hidden Jobs account terms


**JobSpy MCP, borgius** Job-board search and structured JSON/CSV results No submission or application tracking tool documented Search sources include Indeed, LinkedIn and Glassdoor; these are not ATS submission coverage[Local Node.js/Python setup](https://github.com/borgius/jobspy-mcp-server) ; stdio example for Claude MIT code; infrastructure and maintenance are yours


**CV Resume Builder MCP, eyaab** Build a CV from résumé files, git history and supported achievement sources No application submission or tracker documented Résumé preparation, not ATS execution[Local Python/uvx setup](https://github.com/eyaab/cv-resume-builder-mcp) ; stdio examples MIT code; check dependencies and model/client costs


Remote and local servers are not interchangeable in every client. Claude, Cursor, Codex and OpenClaw can have different transport and authentication support. ChatGPT’s custom connection uses a reachable remote endpoint; a local stdio command is not a URL you can paste into it. The table reports documented routes, not an end-to-end test in every named client.


## 1. Tsenta: search, prepare, apply and track through your assistant


Tsenta’s MCP server connects your assistant to your Tsenta account. It can get matching jobs, read role details, start supported applications, work with résumé profiles and inspect application status. It also exposes tracker and inbox tools, including actions that change account data or send replies. Read the approval screen and grant access only to a client you want operating that account.


An application request is queued, not instantly submitted. Product review gates can still pause it for résumé or compatible-form review; Auto Apply has separate settings. Look for the eventual result and inspect the application record before assuming a request succeeded.


The server uses the same account allowance as the dashboard. The first 25 applications are free with no card. Global USD monthly plans are Starter $19 for 600 applications, Pro $39 for 1,500 and Power $99 for 4,500 per 30-day cycle. See[current pricing](https://tsenta.com/pricing) for market and billing options.


### Connect Tsenta in a few steps


1. Create your Tsenta account, upload an accurate résumé and complete profile details such as location and work authorization in the dashboard.
2. Follow the[client-specific setup guide](https://tsenta.com/mcp) and use the hosted endpoint:` https://api.autojobs.me/api/v1/mcp` .
3. Complete browser sign-in and review the account-access request.
4. Start with a read-only request: “Show three matching roles and explain why they fit.” Choose a role before asking the assistant to apply.


Use the platform’s own setup: a **Claude connector** , ChatGPT’s custom MCP connection, a **Codex MCP server** or an **OpenClaw skill** . Compatible clients do not need a separate Tsenta developer product.


## 2. JobGPT: another hosted application service


[6figr’s JobGPT MCP repository](https://github.com/6figr-com/jobgpt-mcp-server) documents search, job hunts, résumé generation,` apply_to_job` , application status and outreach tools. Its setup includes a hosted endpoint with browser sign-in and an alternative key-based route or local server.


The README names Workday, Greenhouse, Lever and LinkedIn as examples of importable job URLs. Importing a URL does not prove full submission support on that platform. Check current limits, the credit price, your target employers and what the final record shows. Its client instructions may also lag the host’s current interface, so cross-check them with the client vendor.


## 3. autoapply-mcp: local control with explicit submission modes


There are several similarly named repositories. This entry is specifically[niragmehta/autoapply-mcp](https://github.com/niragmehta/autoapply-mcp) , whose README separates discovery, eligibility checks, drafting, approval, submission and tracking.


Its default configuration is manual with no companies allowed. Assisted and automatic submission require configuration and browser tooling. The README makes a useful distinction: Workday discovery is supported but applications can require more help, while some newer ATS sources are discovery/manual-packet only until a browser integration exists. Do not convert a discovery-source count into a submission-coverage count.


This is an option for someone comfortable maintaining a local Node.js project and candidate configuration. We reviewed the documentation, not its live form completion.


## 4. Hidden Jobs: remote-job research and saved application context


[Hidden Jobs’ job-search-mcp](https://github.com/hiddenjobs/job-search-mcp) documents remote sources, saved profiles and CV versions, document preparation, PDF export and application outcomes. Its README says the assistant can help submit on the employer website when the client supports it, then record a verified result; you can also report a manual outcome.


That is broader than a search-only connector, but it is not evidence of an independent hosted agent with a universal ATS submission matrix. Check the client’s browser capabilities and the source-specific limits. The repository distinguishes external search results from the offers it can save with full tracking.


## 5. JobSpy MCP: search listings, then decide what to do


[borgius/jobspy-mcp-server](https://github.com/borgius/jobspy-mcp-server) wraps JobSpy searches with filters such as title, location, source and posting age and can return JSON or CSV. Its documented tool is` search_jobs` . It does not document a résumé-tailoring, submission or application-history tool.


Choose it if you want an assistant to collect and compare listings and you are comfortable with local Node.js and Python dependencies. Search access to LinkedIn or Indeed does not mean the server submits their application forms.


## 6. CV Resume Builder MCP: prepare the résumé


[eyaab/cv-resume-builder-mcp](https://github.com/eyaab/cv-resume-builder-mcp) documents CV generation from existing documents, git history and supported achievement sources. It explicitly marks LinkedIn import as not implemented and Jira integration as needing testing. Those limitations matter more than the broad feature headline.


Use it for document preparation if that matches your workflow. It does not document finding jobs or submitting applications, and its “ATS-friendly” wording is not a guarantee of employer acceptance.


## Choosing a server from GitHub or an MCP marketplace


Identify the exact repository and maintainer first. Similar names such as` job-search-mcp` and` autoapply-mcp` can refer to unrelated projects. Read the tool list, distinguish discovery from submission, and check who stores your résumé, answers and mailbox access.


Before a large batch, connect a client, try a read-only search, then test a single relevant application with your chosen review controls. Verify the final result. An MCP marketplace entry describes an integration; it does not establish live success rates or endorsement by a host platform.


## Frequently asked questions


### Is there an MCP server that applies to jobs for me?


Yes. Tsenta exposes tools that start supported cloud applications through your connected assistant, and JobGPT also documents application tools. A request can queue work or pause for review; check the eventual submission result.


### What are the best MCP servers for job search?


Tsenta and JobGPT document application workflows, while JobSpy MCP focuses on listing search. Hidden Jobs combines remote search and saved CV/application context, and local autoapply-mcp offers configurable submission modes. Choose based on the exact action you need.


### Does an MCP server automatically apply to every job it finds?


No. Discovery, eligibility, preparation and submission are separate capabilities. Some servers only return listings, and others require configuration, client browser support or your approval before sending.


### Can I use a GitHub MCP server for job application automation?


Yes, if the specific project documents and implements submission. Check the exact repository, transport, supported employers, approval behavior and result records. A search-only server will not become an application agent simply because an assistant can call it.


### Which clients can connect to Tsenta’s MCP server?


Tsenta provides setup guidance for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex among other MCP clients. Authentication, tool access and account policies vary by host; use the current client-specific instructions at tsenta.com/mcp.


### Is Tsenta listed in the ChatGPT app directory?


This guide does not establish a public directory listing. The documented route is a custom MCP connection to the hosted Tsenta server, subject to the account and workspace features available in ChatGPT.
